tn-04: Vocabulary gap: the question says propriétaire, travaux, logement; COC 749 says bailleur, réparations, preneur, chose louée. Both legs prefer law 76-35 art. 7 (works on old buildings, another regime). The gold reached the top 10 in 2 of 12 runs (best rank 3, A / e5 / dense). Pooling found no other passage that answers it.
tn-05: Same vocabulary gap: COC 768 speaks of the 'prix' paid 'au terme fixé ... par l'usage local'; the question says loyer and date. Results are secondary texts about paying rent (2014 ministry report, blogs). The gold reaches the top 10 in 6 of 12 runs, best rank 6 (B / e5 / hybrid). Pooling found no other passage that answers it.
tn-32: Tunisian dialect: dense search with strategy B finds COC art. 797 at rank 1 with both models; hybrid loses it because the lexical leg ranks art. 758 and 748 first on the words they share with the question (المكري, المكتري) and RRF puts them above. A case where the lexical leg hurts.
tn-37: Transliterated: dense similarity is low (top 0.38 with bge-m3) and the passages are unrelated; the lexical leg matches only the token 'el' (place names such as 'El Omrane' in the colocation blog, 'el' in CDET and law 76-35). Gold in the top 10 in 1 of 12 runs (rank 7, B / e5 / dense).
tn-39: Transliterated: 'sbigha' (painting) matches nothing; the lexical leg matches only 'el'; dense similarity is low (0.41) and the top passages are other lease articles. Gold in the top 10 in 1 of 12 runs (rank 7, A / bge-m3 / dense).
tn-36: Arabic question, French answers (the corpus has no Arabic text on registration apart from COC 729): the dense leg ranks the Diwan guide first, but the lexical leg can only match Arabic text and its Arabic COC articles (sub-letting, rural leases) outrank the guide after fusion; relevant passages come at ranks 9 and 10. A / bge-m3 / dense ranks a relevant passage first.
tn-07: Subletting rules of other regimes come first: rank 1 is art. 20 of the commercial-lease law printed in the same collection as law 76-35, rank 3 is the French rule quoted by a scam guide (both judged not relevant). COC 772 comes at rank 7. Five of the six configurations with strategy A rank a relevant passage first.
tn-11: Rank 2 and 4 are the renewal articles of the commercial-lease law (art. 4 starts 'Par dérogation aux articles 791 et 792 du code des obligations et des contrats') from the same collection document; COC 791-795 comes at rank 6. The document mixes residential and commercial texts under one source, which retrieval cannot tell apart.
tn-09: Dense search ranks the Justice FAQ on COC 788 first (similarity 0.74), but its lexical rank is 26, so after fusion it drops to rank 5 behind passages ranked middling by both legs. A second case where the lexical leg hurts (see tn-32).
tn-38: Transliterated with French words ('colocataire', 'chambre'): retrieval follows those words to the colocation blogs; the houni FAQ on subletting (relevant since v2) is at rank 4. COC 772 (French or Arabic) reaches the top 10 in no run.
